entries.client: A Doha creative agency, for a Gulf tourism board
entries.scope: WebGL 360° tourism campaign. GPGPU particle reveal, three VFX modes, depth-driven cloud veil, mobile-first PWA, Paramiko-driven deployment.

CPU-based boids for marine-life behaviour, procedural vegetation on pre-placed geometry, Blender cloth-simulation for ship sails, custom underwater lighting schemes, VFX Graph birds for environmental dynamism — plus a handpainted-skybox bake pipeline + editor-side render-texture automation across HDRP and URP builds.

entries.role: Technical Artist (freelance) — Little Red Dog Games
entries.scope: VFX in Unity's VFX Graph + EmberGen flipbook bakes (explosions, blood splashes), a custom Character PBR shader for stylised character lighting, fog-of-war and terrain-dithering enhancements, plus a 70-shader URP library leaning on a single shared CustomLighting include.
